data.one_liner: A declarative Flutter package for building card games with drag-and-drop, animations, and flexible layouts.
data.what_it_does: A declarative Flutter package for building card games with drag-and-drop, animations, and flexible layouts. It provides standard playing cards and numeric cards out of the box, along with built-in validation for card movements.
use_when: You are building a card game like Solitaire, War, or Memory Match in Flutter.
You need drag-and-drop functionality with movement validation for cards.
You want smooth animations for card movements and flips.
avoid_when: You are building a non-card-based 2D or 3D game that requires a full game engine.
You require complex physics simulations outside of card stacking and dragging.
strengths: Declarative API with no controllers needed
Smooth built-in animations for movements and flips
Supports standard playing cards and custom numeric cards
weaknesses: Requires managing state for the game externally (e.g., via hooks or state management)
